title: M7: pixelelated 0.0.1
description:
## Current qualification — source-overlay UI complete

Published [final evidence and handoff](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/d5e2f78618624cad919afaba6784bef3f7eaf8c7/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-cloud-validator/ui/README.md) at distribution next `d5e2f78618624cad919afaba6784bef3f7eaf8c7`; remote readback verified. Product source remains clean and local/unintegrated: distribution `6f89bc7cecee5972909828103689e2c7c0711c30`, ES `4e410dc9a816cc947f16235ad2b24824b29dd84e`. #512 localized failure/check-busy wording, #513 small-panel help/editor fit and #514 selected-folder empty guidance are fixed and qualified in that ES source. Their inclusion is explicitly tracked here under #508; no pin or installed device changed.

The final UI index has **99 entries: 89 reviewed screenshots, nine rejected screenshots retained, and CF10 final firmware/public adoption pending**. It includes positive scan-to-supported-systems/back, empty-selected/populated-other-library refusal, all changed help variants, interrupted/failed/retried checks, selective folder creation, OAuth UI and restore-finish callbacks. Exact source/catalog identities and explicit unchanged-input reuse are retained. Root verified the full inventory before retiring the guest/compiler, independently confirmed resource absence and all worker seals, and retained 529 final sealed files. Cleanup reclaimed4.86GiB. No build, VM or audit job remains active in this lane.

Full host regression remains **1,311 top-level PASS**, zeroFAIL/SKIP; ordinary VM WebDAV/SFTP each **108 PASS**. #512 unit logic passes183cases/4752assertions; later text-only fixes have separate compile/link/syntax/catalog/vocabulary proof. Existing accepted candidate16/device firmware and the78-frame baseline remain unchanged. The required D-WORKFLOW-155/156 flow-and-reviewed-screenshot process is published in both agent entrypoints, the canonical UI rule and the evidence-index schema. A mechanical title/index check is not semantic screenshot coverage.

**Remaining order:** #510's unanswered release-scope choice for small-file repair → #508 qualified source/pin integration → #507 frozen independent post-candidate16 audit → assembled firmware/public ROCKNIX and clean-install qualification, source/licence and named physical gates. The validator direction is settled; generic save-file organization is not implemented and must not be silently claimed. No new external audit, device build or personal-cloud action has occurred.

**Parallel site track #511/D-WORKFLOW-152/153:** dedicated Herdr workspace pixelelated · Website (wG:p1, pixelelated-web) owns the site and guides; startup trust confirmation is pending. Keep the main lane on #510 → #508 → #507 → firmware qualification. The website source is separate and adds no RC gate. Evaluate GitHub Pages first but choose hosting from requirements; use confirmed pixelelated.com and recheck live DNS before changes. Once published, See instructions can show a QR modal for the relevant guide. Local handheld guidance does not wait for those pages; full-site delivery adds no firmware RC gate. The owner-created private pixelelated/website repository now has published starter8559ab3e and verified blitterbot maintain/push access (#511/D-WORKFLOW-154). Domain pixelelated.com is confirmed. Next: static source and guide build/layout/link proof. The owner configured DNS, and authoritative plus independent resolver readbacks verify the GitHub Pages A/CNAME records and verification TXT. Public serving/HTTPS remain incomplete (HTTP404/certificate mismatch); Pages settings remain unreadable with the current token (403). The site lane owns the remaining hosting work.

P3 GENERIC_X64 qualification and P4 fixes audit are complete on candidate16. All eight findings are resolved. Exact approved cleanup#491 is completed:22 QA disks,42.05GiB recovered and preservation independently verified.

1. **#495/#496 complete: host compiler and proof repaired.** Exact upstream-matched controls, full installed SPIRV package, nine shader checks and independent hashes published on next63ef759a. Failed owners and all interrupted package scopes are preserved.
2. **#492 H700 arm and #497 actual handoff proof COMPLETE.** Accepted compatibility output is present byte-for-byte in the verified firmware. The source repair and failed owners remain preserved; issue reconciliation follows the retained artifacts.
3. **#492 H700 firmware artifact acceptance COMPLETE.** Both DDR variants, raw/update payloads, installed identity, ARM handoff and independent custody verified; physical boot remains separate. Cleanup #493/#494 and its #498 limitation remain recorded.
4. **#492/#503/#506 SM8550 firmware artifact acceptance COMPLETE.** SM8550 firmware artifacts are ACCEPTED from frozen0553c0193ace3aebbefaae5b7b6d49253c2811d9. All737 packages completed; build04 returned0 at16:51:14UTC and its fourzero channels/13seals/exits were verified16:51:39. Independent firmware acceptance passed16:52:00; fourzero channels/3seals/exits and controllerPASS were consumed16:52:09. Raw/update equality, GPT/ABL, lowercase identity,187ARM handoff files,14FEX files, and installed qualified English/French migration copy passed. Independent bundle97367c3235fab7cc6d1ec2b54c390fe7ceff786612f29c9f177aaa288a33fb18 is retained; scratch was removed. Original01 product and02/03 helper failures remain preserved. Source/licence inventory, per-image qualification mapping, named physical smoke and publication remain separate; no Nova deployment or RC designation. Evidence: docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-device-builds/sm8550-resume04/.

5. **#500 RG35XX SP adoption COMPLETE.** Authorized H700 transfer and one reboot applied pixelelated0.0.1 /43d0bc3bf4. Installed-byte/bootloader/DTB equality, changed boot ID, empty queue, original mounts and active interface verified11:25UTC; terminal channels/seals/exits verified11:26UTC. Next: separately named device smoke and other device adoption, corresponding source,14 known licence metadata gaps, public docs and manifest-bound assets. Other hardware actions and publication retain named scope; no RC designation.

Can this be done on the VM? Common software qualification is complete. Compiler controls run in the pinned host container; capacity and compilation are host facts. Physical smoke facts stay separate. SM8550 compilation follows H700 without implying approval to flash either.

**Continuing retention work #493 (majority-scale batch complete):** the maintainer brought this forward and prioritized records of what happened over storing completed VM runs. Assess majority-scale recovery now across old builds, retained images and temporary QA disks. Retain compact verifiable inputs, logs, results, frames and failure explanations. D-INFRA-022 permits a large testing artifact only for a named active or immediately queued test, with an explicit release condition; remove it when that testing completes. A generic fallback or possible future investigation is insufficient. Distinguish cheap guest recreation from a full OS compilation. Execute only a classified guarded cleanup scope with verified dependencies, then continue H700 firmware and SM8550 in that order. No additional drive or RAID conversion is needed merely to retain disposable history; revisit hardware after measuring the retained working set. This refines D-INFRA-018 and remains infrastructure work, not a new RC acceptance gate. Watchers record lifecycle results and the primary actively consumes them; disconnected alerts#395, FOSS observability#432 and RA reset automation#464 remain later work. No Dropbox credential or new RA reset is required.

### M7.P1 — Completed source work (migration portions superseded by #508)

1. **Migration controls and shared state model** — #365 with #356 and fixture correction #390: map applicable actors to T01–T26 assertions, preserve independent settings/content choices, and retain failing controls for the missed transitions. #391 owns inherited partial states; #392 owns missing-remote refusal.
2. **Versioned, repeatable migration** — #356: strict malformed/future-marker handling, numbered steps/journal, failure at tier or marker publication, safe retry and second-device follow. Name the actual older-build compatibility boundary; do not claim RC2 understands a future protocol.
3. **Settings recovery locking** — #320: deterministic concurrent-write and lock-busy controls, then fix stale recovery-record publication.

P1's historical source gate was subsequently qualified on candidate16. D-CLOUD-175/#508 now retires its cloud-folder move/follow engine; retain those proofs as history. Settings recovery locking and format safety remain required.

### M7.P2 — Work in order

1. **Current proxy with no functionality loss** — #361 and #384: reconcile local patches with current upstream, prove >100-game preparation, never count queued work as ready offline, preserve cached sign-in/data and queued base/subset awards through upgrade/reconnect.
2. **Compatible current dependencies** — #362 and #386: libsoup/WebKit build inputs plus glslang, SPIR-V headers, cbindgen and tllist; verified sources, compatibility and package checks. Coupled dependencies retain evidenced parent pins. Distribution ancestry remains frozen by D-WORKFLOW-111.
3. **Remaining software and execution gates** — #310 launch-memory cause/fix, #332 LED script/reselection, #371 push-hook fix, #367 process guard/help, #368 remaining handoff armatures. Diagnostic VM builds are allowed when required to investigate these.

#327's explanation-page source/frame/asset criteria are completed; public site publication remains P5. Upstream contribution #168 can proceed with qualified local fixes; upstream acceptance does not hold the candidate.

### M7.P3 — Work in order

0. **Lowercase pixelelated transition** — #409 identity source, sibling pins, cloud default, active addresses/policies and source controls are complete above. The RGB555 LCD asset system, Ocean splash/ES/theme integration and fresh input freeze are complete; candidate16 installed behavior proof is accepted. No RASTERATOPS predecessor gate. Repeat applicable qualification on new bytes; #409 is completed after final candidate 16 qualification and the P4 audit; old candidate evidence stays historical.

1. **Freeze, cold-build and retain the exact artifact** — #383/#344: distro/ES/splash commits, container digest actually consumed, source inventory, concurrency, fresh lowercase pixelelated root, logs, candidate manifest and digest verification before/after QA. #393/#394 provide corrected activity detection and automatic monitoring for future builds; the completed image keeps its frozen source. #395 retains disconnected delivery as an explicit outstanding infrastructure item; active-session supervision accompanies the durable watcher. A detached status file is not an alert.
2. **Clean install and RC2 upgrade; actual cloud paths** — #354 and #349/#350/#351/#352/#353/#363/#364/#365/#366/#376/#377/#379/#380/#381. Run full VM QA plus required opt-ins, local WebDAV/SFTP/MinIO-S3, independently reset promoted cases, pair migration, interrupted retries/future markers, writer-shaped archives, and injected failing controls.
3. **Preservation, performance and identity** — #361/#362/#384 runtime proofs; #310 memory/launch loops; #364 timing; #327 explanation frame/docs; #332 software fixture/UI evidence; #337 identity/manual update; #357 no upstream reporting; #359 licences. English/French at 640x480 and Nova1280x960, time-to-play and image brand/secret/localisation/source checks.

**Engineering-build gate is not the RC gate.** Image-only acceptance criteria must remain open until the image exists and supplies proof. They do not prohibit that engineering build. An RC claim requires the known software bugs resolved and P4 completed; no RC2 bug waiver carries automatically.

### M7.P4 — Work in order

The fixes review #383/#471 is complete, with all eight findings resolved on rebuilt and qualified candidate16. #375/#382 are the completed initial review and dispositions; do not restart any completed audit. Verified cross-lab receipts and installed resolutions remain retained. The general automatic version/depth policy is later #378, not a missing authorization for this review.

### M7.P5 — Work in order

The four-step order at the top is authoritative. #510 now precedes #508 and #507. The following device/migration paragraphs retain completed history, not authorization to resume a migration or require unpublished fork compatibility. Prior synthetic draft proof is sealed; integration and new device builds wait for the agreed validator contract and affected qualification.

Device-feedback copy follow-up #502 is implemented in a separate ES feature checkout: PREVIOUS OS, MOVE THE FOLDER, automatic folder switching once other devices run pixelelated and are online, and IF FILES STILL NEED MOVING, YOU'LL BE ASKED TO CONFIRM (D-UI-122/123/124). EN/FR source/gettext checks and all four actual640x480/1280x800 frames pass; ES5d2fcb9b and distribution0553 are published, #502 is closed, and accepted SM8550 build04 includes the pin. The installed handheld copy remains unchanged. #504's review found the owner-initiated SP migration incomplete, with discarded as its last completed tier checkpoint: saves/backups point to /pixelelated while content remains /ROCKNIX. The device stayed on the accepted boot, with zero kernel suspend attempts and no retained terminal migration diagnostic. The diagnostic gap was tracked in #505, now closed not planned after #508 replaced the migration approach. The separately authorized wake input and follow-up capture completed. The readable result confirms an incomplete transfer without identifying the underlying cause. Raw device evidence remains local. No confirmation or personal-cloud retry was performed. #504 review is complete/closed after exact-pin source tracing; discarded is a tier checkpoint, not a terminal time. The maintainer later approved #505, then replaced the migration approach entirely under #508/D-CLOUD-175. Keep existing credentials and selected paths; fresh linking opens category choices with /pixelelated defaults; only explicit CREATE FOLDERS seeds selected structure, and explicit folder selection changes pointers, and no automatic join/follow/move remains. #505's diagnostic patch stays isolated and unintegrated, with its issue closed not planned. Host Dropbox inventory and any later named reconciliation action remain private and separate. After #508's focused script/UI proof, freeze the post-candidate16 P5 delta for the newly due independent review #507. Candidate16/#471 qualification remains accepted; the new closure-cadence requirement does not authorize replaying that matrix.

#265 and #344 own manifest-bound release selection/draft tooling, corresponding-source publication, adoption/recovery/release notes and public docs. Preserve the approved support matrix. The current compilation route is #492: preserve completed cleanup#491, retain completed host compiler/proof repairs#495/#496, retain accepted H700 arm05 and build H700 aarch64 from qualified inputs, verify the H700 DDR3/DDR4 artifacts, then build and verify SM8550 after its capacity check. The first physical route remains H700 DDR4 for RG35XX SP with separately approved migration and smoke checks. The GENERIC_X64 artifact cannot be flashed to this handheld. RG35XX SP migration precedes remaining device attachments; each asset needs its own smoke evidence (D-WORKFLOW-100/120). Physical actions, personal-cloud writes and publication retain their named-action gates. Keep unqualified assets held.

## Placement and historical references

M7-wide umbrellas: #383 delivery, #344 release contract, #354 cloud scope. Their titles omit P because they span phases. Other open titles use their owning M7.P phase. An input issue assigned P2 can retain image-only acceptance for P3; title placement does not waive that criterion.

The older #344 headings remain **contract sections**, not this execution queue: contract P0 is historical investigation; contract P1 spans current P2/P3 custody; contract P2 maps to current P3; contract P2b/P3/P4 map to current P5; contract P5/P6 are later work. Cite `#344 contract P2` explicitly rather than renumbering that evidence.
